description: R-PAR-1 PAR-FOLD, SQL-AGG-ORDER, SQL-AGG-SINGLE: What exact Double bits do Var, VarP, StDev, StDevP, Min, Max and Count give over FO (d = 2^53, 1, -2^53) through the same nine routes as the Sum probe (plain scan, primary-key range, index range on k, derived table ordered by id, id DESC, k, k DESC, d, d DESC), one statement per route? Runs on a fresh copy of r-par-1-fold2 opened read-only through DAO OpenDatabase in one process and one STA; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, and every call's result, HRESULT and DBEngine.Errors are captured.
retentionNote: Designed r-par-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
